// diagnostic L0152

Jet.DivergentStatePaths

`{value}` ends in state `{one}` on one path and `{other}` on another.

What

`{value}` ends in state `{one}` on one path and `{other}` on another.

Why

Typestate: after two paths meet, a state holds only when both paths agree — here they do not, so from this point an operation that needs one of these states is rejected.

Fix

Bring both paths to the same state before they meet, or do the work that needs the state inside the path that reaches it.

Worked example
